meta.title: The RFQ becomes bid-restricted once its auction exists

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot edit rfq once the auction is created.”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).

plan.title: The RFQ becomes bid-restricted once its auction exists

assert.say: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing)

expected.message: You cannot edit rfq once the auction is created.
